name: Nikola Bartůšek - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union, of the Agreement between the European Union and the Federative Republic of Brazil on cooperation with and through the European Union Agency for Law Enforcement Cooperation (Europol) and the Federal Police of Brazil
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees to a deal between the European Union and Brazil. Under the deal, Europol, the European Union's law enforcement agency, and Brazil's Federal Police can share information, including personal data, to fight serious crime and terrorism. This covers drug trafficking, cybercrime, money laundering, corruption and illegal migration. The agreement includes safeguards for privacy and data protection, and the European Data Protection Supervisor said these safeguards are adequate. Parliament's consent is needed before the deal can be concluded.

- Europol and Brazil's Federal Police can exchange personal and non-personal data to fight crime.
- It affects police cooperation between the European Union and Brazil, and people whose data is shared.
- Parliament has given its consent, so the Council can now conclude the agreement.
